title: Vegetable Fruit Smoothie
summary: These easy, kid-approved vegetable fruit smoothies are a delicious way to pack in nutrients without the fuss—perfect for busy mornings, snacks, or even picky eaters.
ingredients: 1 cup fresh or frozen baby spinach
1 cup unsweetened almond milk (or any milk of choice)
1 tablespoon chia seeds or ground flaxseed
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender, starting with the almond milk for easier blending. Blend on high until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust the consistency by adding more milk if it’s too thick, or a handful of ice for a frosty texture.
